correctness.rationale: The sixteen-vertex graph and both complexes are precisely specified. Exhaustive exact integer-chain verification enumerates 120 independent four-sets, 52,915 faces of the total cut complex and 12,621 of the dual, checks 392,720 and 70,368 cover incidences in complete acyclic matchings, and computes the signed Morse differentials (2), 0 and 0, (-2), respectively. The integral homology with two-torsion and free rank 45 follows; the critical-cell dimensions prove five- and four-connectivity. The exact integer verifier and recorded output are embedded; a separate mod-two verifier uses a different independence-number recurrence and raw simplicial boundary reductions and obtains the expected extra torsion-detection Betti numbers. No homotopy wedge splitting is claimed.

value.rationale: The connected, highly symmetric, triangle-free Clebsch graph is a canonical strongly regular graph, and total four-cuts are a natural next parameter beyond the studied total two/three-cuts. Establishing genuine order-two integral torsion and 45 free generators in a different dimension, together with the dual calculation, distinguishes this natural instance from many sphere-wedge classifications. This is an exact, motivated boundary phenomenon rather than an arbitrary numerical slice; no unsupported all-graphs novelty or downstream theorem is claimed.
